items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: D. Or was a drummer. He followed music and went on to play with pretty big time bands in St. Louis and around.

ctx.x: D. Or was a drummer. He followed music and went on to play with pretty big time bands in St. Louis and around. And Charlie Potts, who was a saxophonist and clarinetist. He was, he was good. He was a member of a family who had a big jewelry business. So when the time came for him to go into business, he just had to leave the saxophone alone. But I think those, there were several of those fellows who really were ace musicians.
Would you be listening to black bands like Alfonso Trent, Troy Floyd, Don Albert?
